stemMd: If a is 40% greater than b and b is positive, b is what fraction of a?
explanationMd: The statement means a=1.4b=(7/5)b. Rearranging gives b/a=5/7. Percentage comparisons reverse by reciprocation, not by subtracting the same percentage.

distractorRationale.a: This is the increase relative to b, not b/a.
distractorRationale.e: This is the reciprocal of the increase proportion.
distractorRationale.d: This is a/b, the reversed ratio.
